set-variable.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java var rows = vars.salesRows default [] var codes = (rows map $.country_code) filter ((c) -> c != null and (c as String default "") != "") var currs = (rows map $.currency) filter ((c) -> c != null and (c as String default "") != "") --- { rowCount: sizeOf(rows), uniqueCountryCodes: namesOf((codes groupBy ((x) -> x))), uniqueCurrencies: namesOf((currs groupBy ((x) -> x))) }]
set-variable.doc:name: Unique keys (DW)

logger.doc:name: File read summary
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java --- do { var cid = vars.correlationId default "n/a" var s = vars.salesBatchSummary --- "[correlationId=" ++ cid ++ "] file read | rows=" ++ (s.rowCount as String) ++ " | distinct country codes=" ++ (sizeOf(s.uniqueCountryCodes) as String) ++ " | distinct currencies=" ++ (sizeOf(s.uniqueCurrencies) as String) }]
